summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop catalog + every electric site page: Sunrise Vista = Arnica, Harebell, Rosecrown (74 basic) + Larkspur, Lupine, Yarrow (37 electric, 50-amp). Changed count 113 -> 111, max rig 30 -> 45, season year-round -> 05-28 to 09-30 (the 'electric loop open in winter' was wrong: winter camping is the marina parking lot). Added water/sewer false, pull-through, booking url/window/fcfs never/14-night max. All 111 sites take 23 ft+. Fees unchanged ($28 basic, $36 electric). Note rewritten.
flags: Season: the stored year-round (from a note saying the electric loop stays open in winter) is contradicted by CPW: Sunrise Vista is summer-only (Friday before Memorial Day - Sept 30); winter camping is 8 spots in the marina parking lot.
Max length: the stored 30 ft was wrong; cpwshop lists 25-45 ft, and every one of the 111 sites takes 23 ft or more.
Site count: cpwshop 111 (001-113 less two numbers); the old note said 113. CPW says 181 campsites for the park, cpwshop 182 (111 here + 71 at Dutch Hill).
Pin is 62 m from the centroid of the 111 site points (40.80920,-106.96772). Fine.
Open now: closed for the season since Sept 30 (ordinary); no closure notice.
